en.text: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,

zhSimplified.text: 第三日，大卫和跟随他的人到了洗革拉。亚玛力人已经侵夺南地，攻破洗革拉，用火焚烧，

zhTraditional.text: 第三日，大衛和跟隨他的人到了洗革拉。亞瑪力人已經侵奪南地，攻破洗革拉，用火焚燒，

en.text: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them off and went their way.

zhSimplified.text: 掳了城内的妇女和其中的大小人口，却没有杀一个，都带着走了。

zhTraditional.text: 擄了城內的婦女和其中的大小人口，卻沒有殺一個，都帶着走了。

en.text: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫和跟随他的人到了那城，不料，城已烧毁，他们的妻子儿女都被掳去了。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛和跟隨他的人到了那城，不料，城已燒毀，他們的妻子兒女都被擄去了。

en.text: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫和跟随他的人就放声大哭，直哭得没有气力。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛和跟隨他的人就放聲大哭，直哭得沒有氣力。

en.text: David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫的两个妻—耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻的迦密人亚比该，也被掳去了。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛的兩個妻－耶斯列人亞希暖和作過拿八妻的迦密人亞比該，也被擄去了。

en.text: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in the LORD his God.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫甚是焦急，因众人为自己的儿女苦恼，说：「要用石头打死他。」大卫却倚靠耶和华—他的 神，心里坚固。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛甚是焦急，因眾人為自己的兒女苦惱，說：「要用石頭打死他。」大衛卻倚靠耶和華－他的上帝，心裏堅固。

en.text: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” brought the ephod to David.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫对亚希米勒的儿子祭司亚比亚他说：「请你将以弗得拿过来。」亚比亚他就将以弗得拿到大卫面前。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛對亞希米勒的兒子祭司亞比亞他說：「請你將以弗得拿過來。」亞比亞他就將以弗得拿到大衛面前。

en.text: David inquired of the LORD, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue, for you will surely overtake them, and will without fail recover all.”

zhSimplified.text: 大卫求问耶和华说：「我追赶敌军，追得上追不上呢？」耶和华说：「你可以追，必追得上，都救得回来。」

zhTraditional.text: 大衛求問耶和華說：「我追趕敵軍，追得上追不上呢？」耶和華說：「你可以追，必追得上，都救得回來。」

en.text: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，大卫和跟随他的六百人来到比梭溪；有不能前去的就留在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，大衛和跟隨他的六百人來到比梭溪；有不能前去的就留在那裏。

en.text: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over the brook Besor.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫却带着四百人往前追赶，有二百人疲乏，不能过比梭溪，所以留在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛卻帶着四百人往前追趕，有二百人疲乏，不能過比梭溪，所以留在那裏。

en.text: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.

zhSimplified.text: 这四百人在田野遇见一个埃及人，就带他到大卫面前，给他饼吃，给他水喝，

zhTraditional.text: 這四百人在田野遇見一個埃及人，就帶他到大衛面前，給他餅吃，給他水喝，

en.text: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, and drank no water for three days and three nights.

zhSimplified.text: 又给他一块无花果饼，两个葡萄饼。他吃了，就精神复原；因为他三日三夜没有吃饼，没有喝水。

zhTraditional.text: 又給他一塊無花果餅，兩個葡萄餅。他吃了，就精神復原；因為他三日三夜沒有吃餅，沒有喝水。

en.text: David asked him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from?” He said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I got sick.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫问他说：「你是属谁的？你是哪里的人？」他回答说：「我是埃及的少年人，是亚玛力人的奴仆；因我三日前患病，我主人就把我撇弃了。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛問他說：「你是屬誰的？你是哪裏的人？」他回答說：「我是埃及的少年人，是亞瑪力人的奴僕；因我三日前患病，我主人就把我撇棄了。

en.text: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们侵夺了基利提的南方和属犹大的地，并迦勒地的南方，又用火烧了洗革拉。」

zhTraditional.text: 我們侵奪了基利提的南方和屬猶大的地，並迦勒地的南方，又用火燒了洗革拉。」

en.text: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.”

zhSimplified.text: 大卫问他说：「你肯领我们到敌军那里不肯？」他回答说：「你要向我指着 神起誓，不杀我，也不将我交在我主人手里，我就领你下到敌军那里。」

zhTraditional.text: 大衛問他說：「你肯領我們到敵軍那裏不肯？」他回答說：「你要向我指着上帝起誓，不殺我，也不將我交在我主人手裏，我就領你下到敵軍那裏。」

en.text: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

zhSimplified.text: 那人领大卫下去，见他们散在地上，吃喝跳舞，因为从非利士地和犹大地所掳来的财物甚多。

zhTraditional.text: 那人領大衛下去，見他們散在地上，吃喝跳舞，因為從非利士地和猶大地所擄來的財物甚多。

en.text: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫从黎明直到次日晚上，击杀他们，除了四百骑骆驼的少年人之外，没有一个逃脱的。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛從黎明直到次日晚上，擊殺他們，除了四百騎駱駝的少年人之外，沒有一個逃脫的。

en.text: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.

zhSimplified.text: 亚玛力人所掳去的财物，大卫全都夺回，并救回他的两个妻来。

zhTraditional.text: 亞瑪力人所擄去的財物，大衛全都奪回，並救回他的兩個妻來。

en.text: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.

zhSimplified.text: 凡亚玛力人所掳去的，无论大小、儿女、财物，大卫都夺回来，没有失落一个。

zhTraditional.text: 凡亞瑪力人所擄去的，無論大小、兒女、財物，大衛都奪回來，沒有失落一個。

en.text: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”

zhSimplified.text: 大卫所夺来的牛群羊群，跟随他的人赶在原有的群畜前边，说：「这是大卫的掠物。」

zhTraditional.text: 大衛所奪來的牛群羊群，跟隨他的人趕在原有的群畜前邊，說：「這是大衛的掠物。」

en.text: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫到了那疲乏不能跟随、留在比梭溪的二百人那里。他们出来迎接大卫并跟随的人。大卫前来问他们安。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛到了那疲乏不能跟隨、留在比梭溪的二百人那裏。他們出來迎接大衛並跟隨的人。大衛前來問他們安。

en.text: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said, “Because they didn’t go with us, we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away and depart.”

zhSimplified.text: 跟随大卫人中的恶人和匪类说：「这些人既然没有和我们同去，我们所夺的财物就不分给他们，只将他们各人的妻子儿女给他们，使他们带去就是了。」

zhTraditional.text: 跟隨大衛人中的惡人和匪類說：「這些人既然沒有和我們同去，我們所奪的財物就不分給他們，只將他們各人的妻子兒女給他們，使他們帶去就是了。」

en.text: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which the LORD has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫说：「弟兄们，耶和华所赐给我们的，不可不分给他们；因为他保佑我们，将那攻击我们的敌军交在我们手里。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛說：「弟兄們，耶和華所賜給我們的，不可不分給他們；因為他保佑我們，將那攻擊我們的敵軍交在我們手裏。

en.text: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage. They shall share alike.”

zhSimplified.text: 这事谁肯依从你们呢？上阵的得多少，看守器具的也得多少；应当大家平分。」

zhTraditional.text: 這事誰肯依從你們呢？上陣的得多少，看守器具的也得多少；應當大家平分。」

en.text: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫定此为以色列的律例典章，从那日直到今日。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛定此為以色列的律例典章，從那日直到今日。

en.text: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.”

zhSimplified.text: 大卫到了洗革拉，从掠物中取些送给他朋友犹大的长老，说：「这是从耶和华仇敌那里夺来的，送你们为礼物。」

zhTraditional.text: 大衛到了洗革拉，從掠物中取些送給他朋友猶大的長老，說：「這是從耶和華仇敵那裏奪來的，送你們為禮物。」

en.text: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,

zhSimplified.text: 他送礼物给住伯特利的，南地拉末的，雅提珥的；

zhTraditional.text: 他送禮物給住伯特利的，南地拉末的，雅提珥的；

en.text: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,

zhSimplified.text: 住亚罗珥的，息末的，以实提莫的；

zhTraditional.text: 住亞羅珥的，息末的，以實提莫的；

en.text: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,

zhSimplified.text: 住拉哈勒的，耶拉篾各城的，基尼各城的；

zhTraditional.text: 住拉哈勒的，耶拉篾各城的，基尼各城的；

en.text: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,

zhSimplified.text: 住何珥玛的，歌拉珊的，亚挞的；

zhTraditional.text: 住何珥瑪的，歌拉珊的，亞撻的；

en.text: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.

zhSimplified.text: 住希伯 的，并大卫和跟随他的人素来所到之处的人。

zhTraditional.text: 住希伯崙的，並大衛和跟隨他的人素來所到之處的人。
